points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 奥朗则布出生于莫卧儿帝国德干高原的总督府，是莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗与穆塔兹·玛哈尔的第三子。他接受了全面的教育，包括波斯语、阿拉伯语、伊斯兰教法学和军事战略。这段时期，他展现出对宗教的虔诚和对军事艺术的浓厚兴趣，为他日后的统治奠定了基础。在德干高原，他首次接触到印度南部的复杂地形和多元文化，这影响了他后来对德干地区的统治策略。
points.descriptionEn: Aurangzeb was born in the governor's palace on the Deccan Plateau, the third son of Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal. He received a comprehensive education including Persian, Arabic, Islamic jurisprudence, and military strategy. During this period, he demonstrated piety toward religion and a keen interest in military arts, laying the foundation for his future reign. In the Deccan, he was first exposed to the complex terrain and diverse cultures of southern India, which influenced his later governing strategies for the region.

points.title: 军事历练
points.description: 奥朗则布被派往帝国北部担任军事指挥官，参与了多次军事行动。他在征服拉贾斯坦邦和古吉拉特邦的战役中表现出色，展现出卓越的军事才能。这段经历使他积累了丰富的战争经验，并建立了自己的军事威望。同时，他开始接触印度教文化，与当地王公建立关系，这为他日后统治多元宗教的帝国提供了宝贵经验。然而，他也开始展现出对伊斯兰教正统派的强烈倾向，这成为他日后政策的重要基础。
points.descriptionEn: Aurangzeb was appointed as a military commander in northern Mughal territories, participating in numerous military campaigns. He distinguished himself in the conquests of Rajasthan and Gujarat, demonstrating exceptional military talent. This experience provided him with extensive warfare expertise and established his military reputation. Simultaneously, he began to interact with Hindu cultures and form relationships with local rulers, providing valuable experience for his future rule over a multi-religious empire. However, he also began to show strong inclinations toward Islamic orthodoxy, which would become a foundation for his later policies.

points.title: 德干总督
points.description: 奥朗则布被任命为德干高原总督，负责管理这一战略要地。在此期间，他成功镇压了多次叛乱，并扩展了莫卧儿帝国在德干的领土。他建立了高效的行政系统，促进了当地经济发展。然而，德干地区的长期征战也使他与兄长达拉·舒科等竞争对手产生矛盾。这段经历锻炼了他的统治能力，但也加剧了他与其他王位继承人的权力斗争。他在德干的军事成功为他赢得了军队的支持，这成为他后来争夺皇位的重要资本。
points.descriptionEn: Aurangzeb was appointed as the governor of the Deccan Plateau, responsible for administering this strategically vital region. During this period, he successfully suppressed several rebellions and expanded Mughal territories in the Deccan. He established an efficient administrative system and promoted local economic development. However, the prolonged military campaigns in the Deccan also intensified conflicts with his rivals, including his brother Dara Shikoh. This experience honed his administrative skills but also intensified his power struggles with other claimants to the throne. His military success in the Deccan earned him the support of the army, which became crucial capital in his later bid for the throne.

points.title: 皇位争夺
points.description: 1658年，沙贾汗病重，奥朗则布与他的三个兄弟展开激烈争夺皇位的斗争。他首先击败了达拉·舒科，随后处决了其他兄弟，于1659年在阿格拉正式加冕为莫卧儿皇帝。这一时期，他巩固了权力，镇压了各种叛乱，并开始实施一系列宗教政策。他在阿格拉的统治标志着莫卧儿帝国进入了一个新的阶段，但也埋下了帝国衰落的种子。奥朗则布的统治方式更加专制，对异教徒的政策也日趋严厉，这些变化深刻影响了莫卧儿帝国的未来发展。
points.descriptionEn: In 1658, when Shah Jahan fell ill, Aurangzeb engaged in a fierce struggle for the throne with his three brothers. He first defeated Dara Shikoh, then executed his other brothers, and was formally crowned Mughal Emperor in Agra in 1659. During this period, he consolidated power, suppressed various rebellions, and began implementing a series of religious policies. His reign in Agra marked a new phase for the Mughal Empire, but also sowed the seeds of its decline. Aurangzeb's rule became more autocratic, and his policies toward non-Muslims grew increasingly severe, changes that profoundly influenced the future development of the Mughal Empire.

points.title: 帝国扩张
points.description: 奥朗则布将首都迁至德里，开始了他长达近半个世纪的统治。在此期间，他发动了多次军事行动，将莫卧儿帝国的领土扩张到最大范围。他征服了拉贾斯坦、古吉拉特、信德和克什米尔等地，并将帝国势力延伸到德干高原。他还镇压了锡克教徒的起义，并试图将莫卧儿帝国的影响力扩展到印度次大陆的各个角落。这一时期，莫卧儿帝国达到了领土的巅峰，但频繁的战争也消耗了大量国力，为后来的衰落埋下了伏笔。奥朗则布在德里的统治标志着莫卧儿帝国从文化融合转向宗教保守主义。
points.descriptionEn: Aurangzeb moved the capital to Delhi, beginning his nearly half-century reign. During this period, he launched numerous military campaigns, expanding the Mughal Empire to its greatest territorial extent. He conquered Rajasthan, Gujarat, Sindh, and Kashmir, extending imperial influence to the Deccan Plateau. He also suppressed Sikh uprisings and attempted to extend Mughal influence throughout the Indian subcontinent. This period marked the peak of Mughal territorial expansion, but the frequent wars exhausted the empire's resources, sowing the seeds of its eventual decline. Aurangzeb's reign in Delhi marked a shift from cultural synthesis to religious conservatism in the Mughal Empire.

points.title: 晚年征战
points.description: 晚年的奥朗则布将注意力重新转向德干高原，发动了对马拉塔帝国的长期战争。这场持续了26年的战争消耗了大量人力物力，成为莫卧儿帝国衰落的关键因素。在德干高原的艰苦环境中，奥朗则布的健康状况逐渐恶化，但他仍坚持亲自指挥军事行动。这一时期，他的宗教政策更加严厉，下令拆除印度教寺庙，并对非穆斯林征收额外税收。这些政策引发了广泛的反抗，削弱了帝国的凝聚力。1707年，奥朗则布在德干高原的阿马德讷格尔去世，结束了他近半个世纪的统治，也标志着莫卧儿帝国开始走向衰落。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Aurangzeb refocused his attention on the Deccan Plateau, launching a long war against the Maratha Empire. This 26-year conflict consumed vast resources and became a key factor in the decline of the Mughal Empire. In the harsh environment of the Deccan, Aurangzeb's health gradually deteriorated, but he continued to personally direct military operations. During this period, his religious policies grew harsher, including orders to demolish Hindu temples and impose additional taxes on non-Muslims. These policies sparked widespread resistance and weakened the empire's cohesion. In 1707, Aurangzeb died in Ahmadnagar on the Deccan Plateau, ending his nearly half-century reign and marking the beginning of the Mughal Empire's decline.

appraisal.zh: 奥朗则布常被视为莫卧儿帝国军事与行政力量的顶点，他将版图扩至最大，整饬行政与司法，并扶植波斯与伊斯兰文化。然而学界主流判断是，其宗教正统主义破坏了帝国长期的宽容传统，拆庙、征收吉兹亚税激起反抗，连年征战耗尽国力，专制集权疏离地方贵族，社会分裂加剧，他既是疆域的完成者，也是帝国衰落的始作俑者。
appraisal.en: Aurangzeb is often regarded as the peak of Mughal military and administrative power, expanding the empire to its greatest extent, reforming administration and justice, and patronizing Persian and Islamic culture. Yet the prevailing scholarly judgment is that his religious orthodoxy broke the empire's long tradition of tolerance: temple demolition and the jizya provoked revolt, endless warfare exhausted the state, and autocratic centralization alienated local nobles, deepening social division. He completed the conquests and began the decline.

supporter.zh: 奥朗则布被视为莫卧儿帝国最强大的统治者之一，他成功将帝国领土扩张到最大范围，恢复了帝国的军事威严。支持者认为他是一位虔诚的穆斯林，坚持伊斯兰教法，保护了穆斯林社区的利益。他的行政改革提高了政府效率，建立了公正的法律体系。奥朗则布还重视学术和艺术，在他的支持下，波斯和伊斯兰文化在印度次大陆得到繁荣。他的统治时期被认为是莫卧儿帝国军事和行政力量的巅峰。
supporter.en: Aurangzeb is regarded as one of the most powerful rulers of the Mughal Empire, successfully expanding imperial territories to their greatest extent and restoring the empire's military prestige. Supporters view him as a devout Muslim who upheld Islamic law and protected the interests of Muslim communities. His administrative reforms improved governmental efficiency and established a just legal system. Aurangzeb also valued scholarship and the arts, and under his patronage, Persian and Islamic culture flourished in the Indian subcontinent. His reign is considered the peak of Mughal military and administrative power.

critic.zh: 批评者认为奥朗则布的宗教政策过于严苛，他推行的伊斯兰教正统主义破坏了莫卧儿帝国长期以来的宗教宽容传统。他拆除印度教寺庙、对非穆斯林征收吉兹亚税等政策引发了广泛的不满和反抗。他的军事扩张虽然扩大了帝国版图，但连年的战争耗尽了国力，加速了帝国的衰落。奥朗则布的专制统治风格也削弱了地方贵族的支持，导致中央集权过度。批评者指出，他的政策导致了印度社会分裂，为后来的宗教冲突埋下了祸根。
critic.en: Critics argue that Aurangzeb's religious policies were excessively harsh, and his promotion of Islamic orthodoxy undermined the Mughal Empire's long tradition of religious tolerance. His policies of demolishing Hindu temples and imposing jizya on non-Muslims sparked widespread resentment and rebellion. Although his military expansion enlarged imperial territory, years of continuous warfare exhausted the nation's resources and accelerated the empire's decline. Aurangzeb's autocratic ruling style also alienated support from local nobility, leading to excessive centralization. Critics note that his policies contributed to social division in India and sowed the seeds for future religious conflicts.

objective.zh: 从历史角度看，奥朗则布是一位复杂而矛盾的历史人物。他既是莫卧儿帝国领土扩张的完成者，也是帝国衰落的始作俑者。他的统治代表了莫卧儿帝国从文化多元向宗教保守的转变，这一转变深刻影响了印度次大陆的历史进程。在流行文化中，奥angzeb的形象常常被简化为宗教偏执的象征，但历史学家认为他的政策需要放在当时的历史背景下理解。他的统治既有促进帝国行政效率的积极方面，也有因宗教政策导致社会分裂的消极影响，体现了权力与信仰之间的复杂关系。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Aurangzeb was a complex and contradictory figure. He was both the completer of the Mughal Empire's territorial expansion and the initiator of its decline. His reign represented a shift from cultural pluralism to religious conservatism in the Mughal Empire, a transformation that profoundly influenced the historical trajectory of the Indian subcontinent. In popular culture, Aurangzeb is often stereotyped as a symbol of religious bigotry, but historians argue that his policies must be understood within their historical context. His rule had both positive aspects, such as improving administrative efficiency, and negative consequences, such as social division due to religious policies, reflecting the complex relationship between power and faith.

self.zh: 我既不饮酒，也不听音乐，更不与任何人交往，除了必要的事务外，我从不离开住所。
self.en: I do not drink wine, nor listen to music, nor associate with anyone, and I never leave my residence except on necessary business.
